argument.notTheSessionKey: do not pass dashboard:<slot key>; the chat page compares the value with slot keys
argument.notTheTitle: the slot title and the Ghost name are display text, never an address
argument.slotKey: the slot key: the `key` of the slot the backend created with POST /api/chat/slots

neverCall: openChat() with no slotKey: it opens /chat or /chat?new=1, and ?new=1 creates a chat
openChat({ slotKey, message }): the message is sent into the Ghost's session as a turn
openChat with agent, autoSend, memoryMode or sessionFolder: those are new-chat options
useNavigate()('/chat?new=1') or a bare '/chat' as a stand-in for the session
POST /api/chat/slots from the UI to make a session to link to
contract.pageModel: the app page is a module imported into the dashboard document, so the hook drives the host router directly; there is no frame or postMessage bridge to cross
contract.routeAlias: /chat?slot=<slot key> is read as the same query
contract.sdkLevelGate: none found: useChatLauncher is a plain export at APP_SDK_LEVEL 1
contract.whenSlotKeyUnknownToTheUi: render the link disabled; never fall back to any call above

decision.enableOnlyAfter: every manual step under evidence.unverified passes on the Crew version the demo runs on
decision.result: cannot be proven without a live dashboard -> the design's documented fail-closed fallback applies: Session_Link stays disabled with `contract_unavailable`; never substitute a new chat

inferred: A match in a minified bundle shows the code is shipped, not how a running dashboard behaves: the call shape { slotKey } and the route it resolves to are read from that text.

Opening by sid dispatches the dashboard's switch operation, which loads the slot's history and rejects on a missing slot; the create operation is a separate one reached through new=1 (static/dist/assets, App and chatSlice chunks).
The app page is loaded by module import of /apps/<name>/ui/<ui.entry> into the dashboard document; Crew's sandboxed frames (apps/app_frame.py) serve contribution points, not the page.
useNavigate is the host router's navigate, so the route-only form reaches the same chat page.

The owner's dashboard is not refused an app-owned slot: the ownership checkpoint (dashboard/slot_ownership.py) leaves callers with no app claim untouched, and the slot row sent to the dashboard carries the owner app (dashboard/slot_projection.py).
Chunk names carry a build hash and the hook's internals are not a documented interface, so any other Crew version needs this probe run again.

verified: Crew's shipped dashboard index maps @kirocrew/app-sdk to static/dist/vendor/kirocrew-app-sdk.mjs, which re-exports the host's module registry entry.
That stub exports useChatLauncher and useNavigate next to the hooks the app already uses; the full export list is recorded under sdkExports.

Crew's packaged slot-key helpers, called in the isolated home: a name already in the safe charset is its own slot key, the session key is dashboard:<slot key>, and that session key folds back to the same slot key.

Text presence in the shipped dashboard chunk that implements the SDK (static/dist/assets, App chunk): openChat with a slotKey builds /chat?sid=<slot key> and hands the slotKey to the chat page; the same expression yields /chat?new=1 only when no slotKey is given.
Text presence in the same chunk: the chat page switches to the handed slotKey when it equals the sid query, has a target-unavailable message, and guards creation behind new=1.

guidance.backend: Create slots with a name already in the charset [A-Za-z0-9-] so the name is the slot key, and return the `key` from the create response as the link target.
guidance.disabledDefault: Ship the link disabled with contract_unavailable until the four live steps pass; also disabled when the hook is absent, the slot key is empty, or the page is the replay.
guidance.replayShim: The replay stand-in exports useChatLauncher returning an openChat that does nothing and records the call, so a test can assert it is never reached in replay.
guidance.sdkAdapter: Add useChatLauncher to app/ui/src/adapters/sdk.ts and its typing (useChatLauncher(): { openChat(opts?: { slotKey?: string }): void }). Read it defensively: the stub destructures the host registry, so on a host without the hook the binding is undefined.
guidance.sessionLink: SessionLink receives the slot key from Session_Link metadata in the room-ghosts read route, never from user input, and calls openChat({ slotKey }) with that one property.
